notes.title: Battle Babes 2: Daily Victory Bonus & 200+ Voiceline Proverbs Update!
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

Win of The Day Bonus: Win 1 Solo Battle each day to instantly earn 1,000 coins and 100 gems.

200+ New Voicelines Added: Immerse yourself in battle with fresh, powerful proverbs and wise quips. End Turn on Solo Battle triggers a voiceline. Start buttons on minigames trigger a voiceline.

"Software should elevate us."
